title: Planning the winter team dinner
text:
The winter team dinner is on the second Friday of December. Marco Bellini offered to book the restaurant, and he will bring his husband, since partners are welcome this year. Marco mentioned that the gay bar next to the restaurant hosts a quiz night afterwards, for anyone who wants to stay out.

Ruth Adler reminded us that the date should not clash with Hanukkah, and that she keeps kosher, so the menu needs a fish or vegetarian choice. Samir Haddad is Muslim and does not drink alcohol, so we will order non-alcoholic drinks as well as wine. The restaurant can do all of this if we send the final numbers a week ahead.

Please reply to Marco by the end of the month with your name, whether a partner is coming, and any food needs. The company pays for the meal and the first round of drinks.
